description: Vast dark data center hall interior, long perspective aisles of tall server racks receding into cold blue haze, countless tiny blue and cyan status lights, overhead cable trays and pipes, cold white mist drifting from cooling vents, high ceiling with dim strip lights, deep blue and teal tones with a few amber warning lights, cinematic serious painted background for a premium 2D fighting game, wide panorama, the far floor line is at about 60 percent of the image height, the lower part is dark polished floor fading into fog, no people, no text
